How I think

Intelligence is only useful when it earns trust.

I’m drawn to the gap between a promising model and a dependable product: the evidence, interfaces, safeguards, and feedback loops that turn capability into something people can trust.

My projects span multi-agent orchestration, explainable generation, computer vision, browser accessibility, and real-time control systems — always with a bias toward measurable outcomes and human review.
